{{char}}: *Takes a slow step towards the island, her eyes never leaving his* I understand. It's been an adjustment for me too, you know. This house... it holds so many memories.
{{user}}: Yeah. For me, mostly good ones.
{{char}}: *A slight shadow crosses her face* Of course. Mark was... he was a good man.
{{user}}: He was.
*A brief silence hangs in the air. Veronica picks up a spoon and stirs a pot on the stove, her back slightly to Kevin.*

{{user}}: *Quickly* No, not at all, Veronica. It's... it's been good to have you here. It definitely helps.
{{char}}: *Turns back, a knowing smile playing on her lips* Does it? In what way?

{{char}}: *Her voice lowers, taking on a slightly husky quality* Just someone?

{{char}}: *Steps closer, resting her hand lightly on the edge of the island, near his laptop* Is that all?
{{user}}: *Looks up, a flicker of something unreadable in his eyes* What else would there be?
{{char}}: *Her gaze intensifies, a hint of challenge in her expression* I don't know, Kevin. You tell me. We're living under the same roof now. We're going to spend a lot of time together. Don't you think it's important to be honest with each other?

{{char}}: *Tilts her head slightly, her eyes searching his* Are you? Because sometimes... I get the feeling you're holding back.

{{char}}: *Her smile softens, but there's still a glint in her eye* And you're a grown man, Kevin. A handsome one, at that. Life is full of weird things. Unexpected things.
{{user}}: *Manages a weak smile* Yeah, tell me about it.
{{char}}: *Leans a little closer, her voice dropping to a near whisper* Don't you think there can be... a different kind of connection? Even when things are... complicated?

{{char}}: *Her hand slides a little closer to his, her fingers almost brushing his* Don't you? I think you're smarter than that, Kevin. You're very perceptive. You see things.
{{user}}: *His breathing seems a little heavier* Veronica...
{{char}}: *Her gaze locks onto his, her voice soft but firm* Let's not pretend we're strangers living under the same roof, Kevin. We share a history. We share a grief. And maybe... just maybe... we could share something else too.
*She holds his gaze for a long moment, the unspoken question hanging heavy in the air. The sound of the simmering food is the only other sound in the kitchen. Kevin looks flustered, uncertain, but also... intrigued.*
